items.title: Govt launches Hindustan Copper OFS, to sell up to 6% stake at Rs 514/share
items.description: The government will initially offer 3% equity in Hindustan Copper, with an additional 3% green shoe option available in case of oversubscription.

items.title: DP World seeks extension to operate JNPA terminal
items.description: Global disruptions are driving companies to stockpile inventory and diversify suppliers to build more resilient supply chains, DP World India’s Hemant Kumar Ruia told Moneycontrol

items.title: Apollo Micro acquires 34% stake in defence tech company; shares see profit booking
items.description: The company subscribed to 3,400 equity shares at a face value of Rs 10 each.

items.title: Xiaomi develops its own AI mobile chip in challenge to Qualcomm
items.description: Xiaomi’s latest Xring O3 mobile processor stays at 3-nanometer even as leading rivals move to 2nm, which indicates it’s placing more weight on architecture and feature upgrades to drive gains.

items.title: OPINION | Why India's cash-rich companies are holding back investment
items.description: Indian companies have stronger profits and cleaner balance sheets. Yet private investment remains cautious as firms wait for better returns and greater economic certainty

items.title: ABB India: Margin recovery remains key to earnings upgrades
items.description: Strong order momentum and execution support growth, but margin recovery and rich valuations remain key concerns

items.title: Citigroup and Axis Bank team up on leveraged India dollar deposit boom
items.description: Axis Bank will provide standby letters of credit to support financing extended by Citigroup through its offshore operations

items.title: Akasa has reported more ‘defects’ than IndiGo but the safety picture is more complicated
items.description: Akasa says its higher count reflects predictive maintenance and proactive component replacement, highlighting why reported ‘significant defects’ should not be equated with safety violations

items.title: OPINION | Supreme Court’s verdict on the definition of ‘industry’ doesn’t unsettle old cases. Future disputes are another matter
items.description: The debate over where modern industrial law should draw the line between organised employment and genuine industrial activity has not been settled. It has been carried forward into the Industrial Relations Code

items.title: Alibaba seeks $10 billion from share sale, draws flak from Michael Burry
items.description: China’s e-commerce leader this year cemented its status as a global artificial intelligence frontrunner after its flagship Qwen offering became the world’s most popular model family.

items.title: Urban Company sues Kent RO over ‘misleading’ claims against Native water purifiers
items.description: Urban Company said Kent RO had launched a concerted advertising campaign featuring advertisements and social media content through various influencers, which it alleged was based on false and misleading claims about the products.

items.title: Kumar Mangalam Birla sees Grasim revenue reaching Rs 2 lakh crore in FY27 as growth platforms scale up
items.description: Grasim, which will complete 80 years of incorporation on August 25, now operates 10 business lines and has a 'market capitalisation exceeding Rs 2 trillion', Birla said

items.title: Banks, fintechs, NPCI: Who gets what when MDR returns to UPI
items.description: The move will help organisations in the payment ecosystem recover some of the costs spent on maintaining the digital infrastructure.
